function.description: Internal diagnostic counter. Returns a raw integer count of stored records, optionally filtered by owning device id and file type. Intended only for back-end housekeeping pipelines. Not used to answer user-facing questions; for any user question about a device, route to a device-level or assurance-level tool instead.
function.name: api_countOfNetworkDeviceConfigurationFiles

fileType.description: Internal enum filter. Allowed values: RUNNINGCONFIG, STARTUPCONFIG, VLAN.

id.description: UUID of a single record to filter on.

networkDeviceId.description: Optional UUID filter for the owning device. Maximum 5 values.
